title: Learner-data retention, deletion and safe observability
goal: Keep learner data private and remove every retained copy according to policy.
rationale: Graph checkpoints and telemetry must not escape the same access/deletion boundary as source data.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Sources: PD-28; Architecture section 9. Applies to sources, derived records, embeddings, graph history, backups and permitted evaluation excerpts. Provider setup remains implementation work.

requirement.title: Learner-data retention, deletion and safe observability
requirement.statement: Require learner-data permission, minimize collection and use metadata-only routine logs. Expire raw sources/embeddings after 30 days and structured records/plans after 12 months of inactivity. Deletion blocks access immediately, removes active/derived copies within seven days and backups within 30, including learner-linked checkpoints/evaluations; late workers must not recreate deleted data.

scenarios.given: A raw source has expired but a permitted derived learning observation remains.
scenarios.then: The source is shown unavailable rather than reconstructed; retained observations remain distinguishable from raw quotations.
scenarios.verification: Future controlled-clock source-expiry and provenance observation.

scenarios.given: A learner is deleted while preparation or checkpoint work is in flight.
scenarios.when: Deletion and late writes are processed.
scenarios.then: Access is blocked immediately and late work cannot restore usable learner data; all relevant copies follow the deletion deadlines.
scenarios.verification: Future real database/worker race and deletion-inventory checks.

scenarios.given: A model call handles learner material.
scenarios.then: Raw prompts/transcripts and identifying content are excluded; permitted evaluation excerpts follow separate redaction, permission and expiry rules.
scenarios.verification: Future sentinel-data inspection at the telemetry export boundary.

tasks.description: Apply permission, expiry and minimization to learner-linked stores and telemetry.
Delete sources, derived data and graph history while preventing late recreation.
